name: High knees
cue: Run on the spot driving each knee to hip height, quick feet, arms pumping.

name: Push-up and rotation
cue: Push-up, then at the top rotate into a side plank with one arm reaching to the ceiling; alternate sides each rep.

name: Reverse lunge, elbow to instep with rotation
cue: Step back into a lunge, put the opposite hand on the floor, bring the other elbow to the inside of the front foot, then rotate and reach that arm to the ceiling. Stand and alternate.

name: Push-up to row to burpee
cue: Hands on dumbbells, push-up, row each dumbbell to the ribs, jump the feet in and jump up. Light weights.

name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift to curl to press
cue: Balance on one leg, hinge until the dumbbells reach shin height, stand, curl, press overhead. Same leg for the whole interval.

name: Plank with arm lift
cue: High plank, lift one arm straight out in front without the hips turning, put it down, switch.

name: Lateral lunge to overhead triceps extension
cue: Step wide to the side into a lunge holding one dumbbell at the chest, push back to standing and extend it overhead behind the head. Alternate sides.

name: Farmers carry
cue: A kettlebell in each hand, shoulders packed, walk fast with short steps and a tall chest.

name: Sandbag walking lunge
cue: Sandbag across the shoulders behind the neck, alternate legs, back knee touches the floor each step.

name: Burpee broad jump
cue: Chest to the floor, stand and broad-jump forward with two feet, straight into the next burpee. Count metres.

name: Standing power throw
cue: Back to the line, medicine ball in both hands, dip and throw it backward over the head as far as possible. Score = distance.

name: Sprint-drag-carry
cue: Five 50 m shuttles on a 25 m lane: sprint, backward sled drag, lateral shuffle, kettlebell carry, sprint. For time.

name: Loaded march
cue: Walk or shuffle at pace with the load in a pack or webbing; steady breathing, keep the stride long.

name: Fire and movement
cue: Short tactical bounds: up, sprint, down into cover, repeat; finish with a crawl and a sprint.

name: Casualty drag
cue: Grip the harness or bag, stay low, lean back and drive with the legs walking backward.

name: Water can carry
cue: A jerry can in each hand, shoulders back, walk fast. Stretcher-carry simulation.

name: Vehicle casevac lift
cue: Lift the load from the floor to vehicle-bed height with a flat back, step in close before lifting.

name: Repeated lift and carry
cue: Lift the bag from the floor, carry it the set distance, place it down, return and repeat.

name: Jumping pull-up
cue: Bar about a forearm above the head, jump and pull the chin over the bar, lower to straight arms.
